Hints: Divide the amount by the time or other input; multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.
Solution: (3/4) ÷ (1/4) = (3/4) × 4 = 3. The quotient is the amount per one unit of the denominator quantity. Check: rate × the original time/input recovers the original amount. Exact calculation: (3 ÷ 4) ÷ (1 ÷ 4) = 3.

Question Choices: Write 7/20 as a percentage. (Enter only the number)
Hints: Divide part by whole, then multiply by 100.
Solution: 7/20 = 35/100 = 35%. Percent means per hundred: part ÷ whole × 100. Calculation: 7 ÷ 20 × 100 = 35. Enter 35, the percent number.

Question Choices: A tank contains 42 liters after being filled to 35% of its capacity. Find the total capacity. Enter only the number with no units.
Hints: Divide the known part by the percent written as a decimal.
Solution: The known amount is the stated fraction of the whole: 42 = .35 × whole. Divide: whole = 42/.35 = 120. Check: .35 × 120 = 42.
